'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]]
***[[2025 Bukavu offensive]]
****Mass [[looting]] and sporadic [[gunfire]] is reported in [[Bukavu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], as [[March 23 Movement|M23 rebels]] advance into the city. Mobs loot several facilities, including a [[World Food Programme]] depot. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1m5dppk5xmo (BBC News)]
****The [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese military]] withdraws from [[Bukavu]] heading south towards [[Tanganyika Province]]. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-fighting-bukavu-m23-rwanda-9092314a99030530e43ba73bd332af50 (AP)]
**[[Ituri conflict]]
***General [[Muhoozi Kainerugaba]], [[Chief of Defence Forces (Uganda)|Chief]] of the [[Uganda]]n [[Uganda People's Defence Force|military]], claiming to act with the authority of his father, [[President of Uganda|President]] [[Yoweri Museveni]], threatens to invade the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] and take control of [[Bunia]], the capital of [[Ituri Province]], unless local forces surrender their weapons within 24 hours. Kainerugaba alleges that the [[Hema people]] are being killed.  [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/uganda-military-chief-threatens-attack-eastern-congo-town-bunia-2025-02-15/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|2025 Gaza war ceasefire]]
***[[Hamas]] releases three [[Israelis|Israeli]] [[Gaza war hostage crisis|hostages]] in exchange for the [[Israeli government]] releasing 369 [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] [[Palestinians in Israeli custody|prisoners]], most without [[criminal charge]]s or [[conviction]]s, as part of the first stage of the 2025 ceasefire. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/2/15/israeli-captives-story (Al Jazeera)] [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-ceasefire-hostages-02-15-2025-22a2d731961eb766e6c7914cb84e3990 (AP)]
*[[2025 Munich car attack]]
**A 37-year-old woman and her two-year-old child die as a result of injuries sustained in a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] in [[Munich]], [[Germany]], on Thursday. [https://www.stern.de/panorama/verbrechen/muenchen--kind-und-frau-nach-anschlag-mit-auto-gestorben-35470484.html (Stern)]
*[[2025 Villach stabbing attack]]
**A 14-year-old boy is killed and five other people are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] on a street in [[Villach]], [[Carinthia]], [[Austria]]. A 23-year-old man, an [[Islamic State]] member, is arrested.  [https://apnews.com/article/austria-stabbings-4913f6921c6f27e6d7fd8590da85cc9f (AP)] [https://www.dw.com/en/austria-stabbing-islamist-attack-interior-minister-says/a-71629831 (DW)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict]]
**[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Democratic Republic of the Congo)|Congolese Foreign Minister]] [[Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner]] calls on [[Western world|Western]] sporting firms such as the [[National Basketball Association]], [[Formula One]], and [[Arsenal F.C.]] to cut sponsorship deals with [[Rwanda]] amid the conflict in [[Kivu]]. [https://www.espn.co.uk/nba/story/_/id/43841887/congo-asks-nba-f1-soccer-teams-end-rwanda-deals-surge-violence (ESPN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 New Delhi railway station stampede]]
**A [[crowd collapses and crushes|crowd crush]] kills at least 18 people, including three children, and injures ten others at [[New Delhi railway station]] in [[New Delhi]], [[India]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czj3r0y7849o (BBC News)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/02/15/india/india-crowd-crush-delhi-train-mela-int-latam/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/2/16/children-among-15-killed-in-crush-at-new-delhi-train-station-in-india (Al Jazeera)]
*At least 49 people are killed and several others are injured when a [[gold mining|gold mine]] [[Mining accident|collapses]] in [[Kéniéba]], [[Mali]]. '''International relations'''
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russian Foreign Minister]] [[Sergey Lavrov]] and [[U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Marco Rubio]] speak by telephone about the [[Russo-Ukrainian War]], the [[Gaza war]], the sanctions against Russia, and removing restrictions on each country's diplomatic missions. They also discuss preparations for a high-level summit in [[Saudi Arabia]]. This is the first time the U.S. and Russia had contact at the foreign minister level in almost two years. [https://www.ft.com/content/25c3bcf6-9da7-4c46-9054-d4a0778356c3 (''Financial Times'')]
*[[South Africa–United States relations]]
**Hundreds of [[White South Africans]] hold a protest outside the [[Embassy of the United States, Pretoria|U.S. embassy]] in [[Pretoria]], [[South Africa]], in support of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s claims that the [[Government of South Africa|South African government]] is discriminating against the country's white minority. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-south-africa-white-afrikaners-b41aa729360af4d1d090ea1ac1e22cce (AP)]
*[[Weimar+]]
**[[President of France|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] announces an emergency summit in [[Paris]], [[France]], between [[European Union|European]] leaders following a [[2025 JD Vance speech at the Munich Security Conference|controversial speech]] given by [[Vice President of the United States|U.S. Vice President]] [[JD Vance]] at the [[Munich Security Conference]] in which he criticized European leadership as the worst threat to [[Europe]], particularly for imposing too much [[censorship]] and too little control over [[Immigration to Europe|migration]]. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/3960538-macron-invites-european-leaders-to-paris.html (Ukrinform)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c04nw1pg3k2o (BBC News)] [https://www.voanews.com/a/at-munich-conference-us-vp-vance-warns-european-allies-of-threat-from-within-/7975270.html (Voice of America)]
